                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ k(k − 1)(k + 1) − 2(k + 1) = 0

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ (k + 1)[k(k − 1) − 2] = 0

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ (k + 1)(k2 − k − 2) = 0

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ (k + 1)(k − 2)(k + 1) = 0

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ (k + 1)2(k − 2) = 0

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              This gives k = −1 or k = 2.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Since it is given that a > 0, the sum (a + 1/a) must be a positive number.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ k = 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ a + 1/a = 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ∴ The correct answer is 2.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Algebraic Identities for Squares

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              If x + 1/x = k, then x2 + 1/x2 = k2 − 2. Similarly, if x − 1/x = k, then x2 + 1/x2 = k2 + 2.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Algebraic Identities for Cubes

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              If x + 1/x = k, then x3 + 1/x3 = k3 − 3k. Similarly, if x − 1/x = k, then x3 − 1/x3 = k3 + 3k.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Special Case for Value 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              If x + 1/x = 2, then x = 1. Consequently, xn + 1/xn = 2 for any positive integer n.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(a^3 + \\frac{1}{a^3} = 2\\) (जहाँ (a > 0)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              हमें a + 1/a का मान ज्ञात करना है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1. a3 + 1/a3 = (a + 1/a)3 - 3(a + 1/a)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              2. मान लीजिए x = a + 1/a है x को व्यंजक में प्रतिस्थापित कीजिए।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              दिये गये समीकरण में x = a + 1/a प्रतिस्थापित कीजिए:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              a3 + 1/a3 = x3 - 3x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              हमें दिया गया है a3 + 1/a3 = 2, इसलिए:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              x3 - 3x = 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              घनीय समीकरण को हल कीजिए:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              x3 - 3x - 2 = 0

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              संभावित मूलों का प्रयास कीजिए। मान x = 2 लीजिए:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              23 - 3(2) - 2 = 8 - 6 - 2 = 0

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              इस प्रकार, x = 2 समीकरण का एक मूल है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              परिणाम सत्यापित कीजिए:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              यदि x = a + 1/a = 2, इसलिए शर्त a3 + 1/a3 = 2 सही है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              a + 1/a का मान = 2 है। 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n91:Tf6d,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The correct answer is To promote and facilitate the development of MSMEs.

                                                                                                                                                            प्रतिशत अंतर की गणना कीजिए", "te": "", "mr": "", "bn": "", "ml": "", "gu": "", "kn": "", "ta": "", "or": "", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Tabulation"], "concept": "Data Interpretation", "confidence": "high"}, {"qid": "67160978134c5d06061abd7a", "qs_no": 10, "pos_marks": 2.0, "neg_marks": 0.5, "type": "mcq", "langs": {"en": {"value": "If x2 + 7x + 8 = 0 , then find the value of \\(\\frac{4x}{x^2 - 5x + 8}\\) .", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "<span class="math-tex">\\(\\frac{1}{2}\\)</span>"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "<span class="math-tex">\\(-\\frac{1}{4}\\)</span>"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "<span class="math-tex">\\(-\\frac{1}{3}\\)</span>"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "<span class="math-tex">\\(\\frac{1}{6}\\)</span>"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "यदि x2 + 7x + 8 = 0 है, तो \\(\\frac{4x}{x^2 - 5x + 8}\\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "<span class="math-tex">\\(\\frac{1}{2}\\)</span>"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "<span class="math-tex">\\(-\\frac{1}{4}\\)</span>"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "<span class="math-tex">\\(-\\frac{1}{3}\\)</span>"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "<span class="math-tex">\\(\\frac{1}{6}\\)</span>"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                            Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                            Given: x2 + 7x + 8 = 0 ⇒ x2 + 8 = −7x

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Substitute x2 + 8 = −7x into the given expression:

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 4x / (x2 − 5x + 8) = 4x / (x2 + 8 − 5x)

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 4x / (−7x − 5x)

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 4x / (−12x) = −1/3

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ∴ The correct answer is −1/3.

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Given:

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            x2 + 7x + 8 = 0

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            To find:

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            4x / (x2 − 5x + 8)

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Calculations:

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ Divide the numerator and the denominator of the given expression by x:

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ Expression = (4x / x) / [ (x2 − 5x + 8) / x ]

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ Expression = 4 / (x − 5 + 8/x)

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ Rearranging the terms: 4 / [(x + 8/x) − 5]

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ Now, from the given equation x2 + 7x + 8 = 0, divide by x:

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ x + 7 + 8/x = 0

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ x + 8/x = −7

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ Substitute this value into the expression:

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ Expression = 4 / (−7 − 5)

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ Expression = 4 / −12

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ Expression = −1/3

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ∴ The correct answer is −1/3.

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Dividing by Variable Technique

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            When both the numerator and denominator are polynomials, dividing by x (or x2) helps convert the expression into the form (x + 1/x), making substitution easier.

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Direct Substitution Method

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Instead of finding the exact roots of a quadratic equation, rearranging the equation to isolate parts of it (like x2 + constant) and substituting it into the target expression saves significant calculation time.

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Properties of Quadratic Equations

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            For a standard quadratic equation ax2 + bx + c = 0, the sum of roots is −b/a and the product of roots is c/a. These algebraic relationships can often be used to simplify symmetric expressions.

                                                                                                                                                            दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            द्विघात समीकरण है:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            x² + 7x + 8 = 0

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            हमें इसका मान ज्ञात करना है:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            (4x) / (x² - 5x + 8)

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            हल:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            दिए गए द्विघात समीकरण का उपयोग करके हर (x² - 5x + 8) को सरल कीजिए:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            x² + 7x + 8 = 0 से, हम जानते हैं:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            x² = -7x - 8

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            (x² - 5x + 8) में x² = -7x - 8 रखने पर:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            x² - 5x + 8 = (-7x - 8) - 5x + 8

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            = -7x - 5x - 8 + 8

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            = -12x

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            इसलिए, हर -12x हो जाता है।

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            व्यंजक में प्रतिस्थापित करने पर:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            (4x) / (x² - 5x + 8) = (4x) / (-12x)

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            = 4 / -12

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            = -1/3

{"prompt": "4", "value": "5%"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                            Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                            Total Simple Interest = 3/5 of the sum = 60% of the sum.

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            This 60% interest is generated over a period of 6 years.

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Rate per annum = Total Interest % ÷ Time = 60% ÷ 6 = 10%.

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ∴ The correct answer is 10%.

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Given:

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Simple Interest (SI) = 3/5 × Principal (P)

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Time (T) = 6 years

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            Calculations:

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 3/5 × P = (P × R × 6) ÷ 100

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 3/5 = (R × 6) ÷ 100

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 300 ÷ 5 = R × 6

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 60 = R × 6

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ R = 60 ÷ 6 = 10

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ∴ The correct answer is 10%.

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Simple Interest Formula

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Simple Interest is calculated only on the initial principal amount. The formula is SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100.

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Amount Formula

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            The total amount at the end of the time period is Amount (A) = Principal (P) + Simple Interest (SI). It can be expressed as A = P[1 + (R × T) ÷ 100].

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Effective Interest Rule

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            For simple interest, the overall effective interest rate over T years is simply R × T%.

                                                                                                                                                            दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            6 वर्षों का साधारण ब्याज (SI) = धनराशि (मूलधन, P) का तीन-पाँचवाँ भाग।

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            साधारण ब्याज (SI) = (मूलधन × दर × समय) / 100

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            गणना:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            माना, मूलधन P है।

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            दिया गया है, SI = (3/5)P

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            समय (T) = 6 वर्ष

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            दर (R) = ?

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            हम जानते हैं, SI = (P × R × 6) / 100

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ (3/5)P = (P × R × 6) / 100

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ (3/5) = (R × 6) / 100

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 3 × 100 = R × 6 × 5

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 300 = 30R

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ R = 300 / 30

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ R = 10

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            प्रति वर्ष ब्याज दर 10% है।

                                                                                                                                                            ६ वर्षांसाठी साधे व्याज (SI) = रकमेच्या तीन-पंचमांश (मुद्दल, P).

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            वापरलेले सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            साधे व्याज (SI) = (मुद्दल × दर × वेळ) / १००

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            गणना:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            प्राचार्य पी असू द्या.

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            दिले तर, SI = (3/5)P

                                                                                                                                                            वेळ (T) = 6 वर्षे

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            दर (R) = ?

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            आपल्याला माहिती आहे, SI = (P × R × 6) / 100

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ (३/५)P = (P × R × ६) / १००

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ आर = १०

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            योग = 44142

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            वर्षों की संख्या = 7

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            औसत = 44142 ÷ 7 = 6306
