                                                                                                                                                            इसलिए, सभी वर्षों में औसत आयात 6306 हजार टन है।

                                                                                                                                                            \n", "te": "", "mr": "", "bn": "", "ml": "", "gu": "", "kn": "", "ta": "", "or": "", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Bar Graph"], "concept": "Bar Graph", "confidence": "high"}, {"qid": "671609779213b79f20593859", "qs_no": 13, "pos_marks": 2.0, "neg_marks": 0.5, "type": "mcq", "langs": {"en": {"value": "If the lengths of two sides of an isosceles triangle are 6 cm and 12 cm, then find the length of the third side.", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "8 cm"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "6 cm"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "12 cm"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "14 cm"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "यदि एक समद्विबाहु त्रिभुज की दो भुजाओं की लंबाई 6 cm और 12 cm है, तो तीसरी भुजा की लंबाई ज्ञात कीजिए।", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "8 cm"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "6 cm"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "12 cm"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "14 cm"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                            Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                            In an isosceles triangle, two sides are equal, so the third side is either 6 cm or 12 cm.

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            According to the triangle inequality theorem, the sum of any two sides must be strictly greater than the third side.

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            If sides are 6 cm, 6 cm, and 12 cm: 6 + 6 = 12 (not greater than 12, so it is invalid).

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            If sides are 12 cm, 12 cm, and 6 cm: 12 + 6 = 18 > 12 (satisfies the condition, so it is valid).

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ∴ The correct answer is 12 cm.

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Given:

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Length of two sides of an isosceles triangle = 6 cm and 12 cm.

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Concept Used:दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            एक समद्विबाहु त्रिभुज की दो भुजाओं की लंबाई 6 cm और 12 cm है। हमें तीसरी भुजा की लंबाई ज्ञात करनी है।

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            प्रयुक्त अवधारणा:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            एक समद्विबाहु त्रिभुज में, दो भुजाएँ समान लंबाई की होती हैं। इस प्रकार, तीसरी भुजा होनी चाहिए:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            या तो 6 cm के बराबर (यदि 12 cm आधार है)

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            या 12 cm के बराबर (यदि 6 cm आधार है)

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            हल:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            त्रिभुज के अस्तित्व के लिए, किन्हीं भी दो भुजाओं का योग, तीसरी भुजा से अधिक होना चाहिए (त्रिभुज असमिका प्रमेय)।

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            संभावित विन्यासों की जाँच कीजिए:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            स्थिति 1: यदि समान भुजाएँ प्रत्येक 6 cm की है:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            आधार = 12 cm।

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            त्रिभुज असमिका की जाँच कीजिए:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            6 + 6 = 12 (12 के बराबर, अधिक नहीं)।

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            इस स्थिति में त्रिभुज मौजूद नहीं है।

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            स्थिति 2: यदि समान भुजाएँ प्रत्येक 12 cm की है:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            आधार = 6 cm।

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            त्रिभुज असमिका की जाँच कीजिए:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            12 + 12 = 24 (6 से अधिक)।

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            12 + 6 = 18 (12 से अधिक)।

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            इस स्थिति में त्रिभुज मौजूद है।

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            इसलिए, तीसरी भुजा की लंबाई 6 cm है, और जब समान भुजाएँ प्रत्येक 12 cm हैं, तो त्रिभुज मान्य है।

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n115:Tc4b,\n

                                                                                                                                                            Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                            The difference in ages is always constant over time. Difference in present ages = 30 − 25 = 5 years.

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            In the past, the ratio was 3 : 4. Difference in ratio parts = 4 − 3 = 1 part.

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            So, 1 part = 5 years.

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Past age of Nihira = 3 parts = 3 × 5 = 15 years.

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Number of years ago = Present age − Past age = 25 − 15 = 10 years.

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ∴ The correct answer is 10 years.

                                                                                                                                                            दिन", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "9 : 10"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "11 : 10"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "10 : 11"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "10 : 9"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "4", "solution_html": {"en": "

                                                                                                                                                            Calculation:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            Total pages printed by printer P over three days:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            Pages printed by P = 100 (Monday) + 120 (Tuesday) + 180 (Wednesday)

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            Total pages by P = 100 + 120 + 180 = 400

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            Total pages printed by printer Q over three days:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            Pages printed by Q = 130 (Monday) + 145 (Tuesday) + 85 (Wednesday)

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            Total pages by Q = 130 + 145 + 85 = 360

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            Find the ratio:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            Ratio of pages printed by P to Q = Total pages by P : Total pages by Q

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            Ratio = 400 : 360

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            Simplify the ratio:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            400 ÷ 40 : 360 ÷ 40 = 10 : 9

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            Therefore, the ratio of the total pages printed by P to Q is 10 : 9.

                                                                                                                                                            \n", "hn": "

                                                                                                                                                            गणना:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            तीन दिनों में प्रिंटर P द्वारा छापे गए कुल पृष्ठ:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            P द्वारा छापे गए पृष्ठ = 100 (सोमवार) + 120 (मंगलवार) + 180 (बुधवार)

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            P द्वारा कुल पृष्ठ = 100 + 120 + 180 = 400

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            तीन दिनों में प्रिंटर Q द्वारा छापे गए कुल पृष्ठ:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            Q द्वारा छापे गए पृष्ठ = 130 (सोमवार) + 145 (मंगलवार) + 85 (बुधवार)

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            Q द्वारा कुल पृष्ठ = 130 + 145 + 85 = 360

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            अनुपात ज्ञात कीजिए:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            P और Q द्वारा छापे गए पृष्ठों का अनुपात = P द्वारा कुल पृष्ठ : Q द्वारा कुल पृष्ठ

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            अनुपात = 400 : 360

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            अनुपात को सरल कीजिए:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            400 ÷ 40 : 360 ÷ 40 = 10 : 9

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            इसलिए, P और Q द्वारा छापे गए कुल पृष्ठों का अनुपात 10 : 9 है।

                                                                                                                                                            \n", "te": "", "mr": "", "bn": "", "ml": "", "gu": "", "kn": "", "ta": "", "or": "", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Tabulation"], "concept": "Data Interpretation", "confidence": "high"}, {"qid": "67160977922d29b22cf46030", "qs_no": 15, "pos_marks": 2.0, "neg_marks": 0.5, "type": "mcq", "langs": {"en": {"value": "Nihira is 25 years old and Punith is 30 years old. How many years ago was the ratio of their ages 3 : 4?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "20 years"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "15 years"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "5 years"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "10 years"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "निहारिका की आयु 25 वर्ष है और पुनीत की आयु 30 वर्ष है। कितने वर्ष पहले उनकी आयु का अनुपात 3 : 4 था?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "20 वर्ष"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "15 वर्ष"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "5 वर्ष"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "10 वर्ष"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "bn": {"value": "নিহিরার বয়স 25 বছর এবং পুণিতের বয়স 30 বছর। কত বছর আগে তাদের বয়সের অনুপাত 3 : 4 ছিল?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "20 বছর"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "15 বছর"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "5 বছর"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "10 বছর"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "gu": {"value": "નિહિરા 25 વર્ષની અને પુનિત 30 વર્ષનો છે. કેટલા વર્ષ પહેલાં તેમની ઉંમરનો ગુણોત્તર 3:4 હતો?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "20 વર્ષ"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "15 વર્ષ"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "5 વર્ષ"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "10 વર્ષ"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "ta": {"value": "நிஹிராவுக்கு 25 வயதும் புனித்துக்கு 30 வயதும் உள்ளது. எத்தனை ஆண்டுகளுக்கு முன்பு அவர்களின் வயது விகிதம் 3 : 4 ஆக இருந்தது?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "20 ஆண்டுகள்"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "15 ஆண்டுகள்"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "5 ஆண்டுகள்"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "10 ஆண்டுகள்"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "pa": {"value": "ਨਿਹਾਰਾ 25 ਸਾਲ ਦੀ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਪੁਨੀਤ 30 ਸਾਲ ਦਾ ਹੈ। ਕਿੰਨੇ ਸਾਲ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦੀ ਉਮਰ ਦਾ ਅਨੁਪਾਤ 3:4 ਸੀ?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "20 ਸਾਲ"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "15 ਸਾਲ"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "5 ਸਾਲ"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "10 ਸਾਲ"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "4", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                            Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                            The difference in ages is always constant over time. Difference in present ages = 30 − 25 = 5 years.

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            In the past, the ratio was 3 : 4. Difference in ratio parts = 4 − 3 = 1 part.

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            So, 1 part = 5 years.

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Past age of Nihira = 3 parts = 3 × 5 = 15 years.

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Number of years ago = Present age − Past age = 25 − 15 = 10 years.

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ∴ The correct answer is 10 years.

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n\n\n

                                                                                                                                                            Given:

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Present age of Nihira = 25 years

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Present age of Punith = 30 years

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Let the required number of years ago be x.

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Calculation:

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ x years ago, Nihira's age = (25 − x) years

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ x years ago, Punith's age = (30 − x) years

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            According to the given condition, their age ratio was 3 : 4.

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ (25 − x) / (30 − x) = 3 / 4

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Cross-multiplying the equation:

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 4 × (25 − x) = 3 × (30 − x)

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 100 − 4x = 90 − 3x

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 100 − 90 = 4x − 3x

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ x = 10

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ∴ The correct answer is 10 years.

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            Constant Age Difference Rule

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            The difference between the ages of two individuals remains exactly the same regardless of the time period (past, present, or future).

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            Ratio of Ages in Future/Past

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            If the present ages are A and B, then 't' years ago, their age ratio was (A − t) : (B − t), and 't' years hence, it will be (A + t) : (B + t).

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            Cross-Multiplication Method

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            When comparing two ratios at two different points in time, you can directly equate the differences of cross products to the time gap to find the 1-unit multiplier quickly.

                                                                                                                                                            दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            निहारिका की वर्तमान आयु = 25 वर्ष।

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            पुनीत की वर्तमान आयु = 30 वर्ष।

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            मान लीजिए ज्ञात करने योग्य वर्ष x है।

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            तब, (निहारिका की आयु - x) / (पुनीत की आयु - x) = 3 / 4

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            गणना:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            मान लीजिए ज्ञात करने योग्य वर्ष x है।

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            तब, (25 - x) / (30 - x) = 3 / 4

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 4 × (25 - x) = 3 × (30 - x)

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 100 - 4x = 90 - 3x

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 100 - 90 = 4x - 3x

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 10 = x

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            x = 10 वर्ष

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

(ત્રણ દશાંશ સ્થાનો સુધી સાચું, π = 22/7 વાપરો)", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "9.244"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "2.439"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "3.924"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "4.329"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                            Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                            Base Circumference = 2πr = 154 ⇒ r = 154 × (7/44) = 24.5 cm.

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Height = 49 mm = 4.9 cm.

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Volume (cm3) = πr2h = (22/7) × 24.52 × 4.9 = 9243.85 cm3.

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Capacity in Litres = 9243.85 ÷ 1000 = 9.24385 Litres ≈ 9.244 Litres.

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ∴ The correct answer is 9.244 Litres.

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Given:

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Circumference of the base = 154 cm

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Height of the cylinder (h) = 49 mm = 4.9 cm

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Circumference of a circle = 2πr

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Volume of a cylinder = πr2h

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            1 Litre = 1000 cm3

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n\n\n

                                                                                                                                                            Calculation:

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 2 × (22/7) × r = 154

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ (44/7) × r = 154

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ r = (154 × 7) ÷ 44

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ r = 24.5 cm

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ Volume of the vessel = (22/7) × (24.5)2 × 4.9

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ Volume = (22/7) × 600.25 × 4.9

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ Volume = 22 × 600.25 × 0.7

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ Volume = 9243.85 cm3

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Since 1000 cm3 = 1 Litre:

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ Capacity in Litres = 9243.85 ÷ 1000 = 9.24385 Litres

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ Correct to three places of decimals ≈ 9.244 Litres

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            ∴ The correct answer is 9.244 Litres.

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Volume and Surface Area of a Cylinder

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2πrh | Total Surface Area (TSA) = 2πr(r + h) | Volume = πr2h

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            Liquid Capacity Conversions

                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                            1 m3 = 1000 Litres | 1 Litre = 1000 cm3 | 1 cm3 = 1 millilitre (ml)

                                                                                                                                                            दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            बेलनाकार बर्तन के आधार की परिधि = 154 सेमी

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            बर्तन की ऊँचाई = 49 मिमी = 4.9 सेमी

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            हमें π = 22/7 का उपयोग करके, लीटर में बेलन का आयतन ज्ञात करना है।

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            एक बेलन का आयतन दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            आयतन = π x r² x h

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            जहाँ:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            r आधार की त्रिज्या है

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            h बेलन की ऊँचाई है

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            गणना:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            चरण 1: आधार की त्रिज्या ज्ञात कीजिए:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            परिधि = 2 x π x r

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            154 = 2 x (22/7) x r

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            r = (154 x 7) / (2 x 22)

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            r = 1078 / 44 ≈ 24.5 सेमी

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            चरण 2: बेलन का आयतन परिकलित कीजिए:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            आयतन = π x r² x h

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            आयतन = (22/7) x (24.5)² x 4.9

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            r² = 24.5 x 24.5 = 600.25

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            आयतन = (22/7) x 600.25 x 4.9

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            आयतन = (22 x 600.25 x 4.9) / 7

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            आयतन = 9243.85 ≈ 9244 सेमी³

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            आयतन को लीटर में बदलिए:

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            1 लीटर = 1000 सेमी³

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            लीटर में आयतन = 9244 / 1000 = 9.244 लीटर

                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                            इसलिए, बर्तन लगभग 9.244 लीटर पानी धारण कर सकता है।

                                                                                                                                                              \n\t Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                              Direct Common Tangent (DCT) = √[d2 − (r1 − r2)2] = √[362 − 62] = √1260 = 6√35 cm

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Transverse Common Tangent (TCT) = √[d2 − (r1 + r2)2] = √[362 − 242] = √720 = 12√5 cm

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Total sum of tangents = 6√35 + 12√5 = 6√5(√7 + 2) cm

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ∴ The correct answer is 6√5(√7 + 2) cm.

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Given:

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Distance between centers (d) = 36 cm

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Radius of larger circle (r1) = 15 cm

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Radius of smaller circle (r2) = 9 cm

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Length of DCT = √[d2 − (r1 − r2)2]

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Length of TCT = √[d2 − (r1 + r2)2]

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              Calculations:

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ DCT = √[362 − (15 − 9)2]

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ DCT = √[362 − 62] = √[(36 − 6) × (36 + 6)]

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ DCT = √[30 × 42] = √1260 = 6√35 cm

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ TCT = √[362 − (15 + 9)2]

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ TCT = √[362 − 242] = √[(36 − 24) × (36 + 24)]

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ TCT = √[12 × 60] = √720 = 12√5 cm

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ Sum of DCT and TCT = 6√35 + 12√5

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ Sum = 6√5 × √7 + 6√5 × 2

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ Sum = 6√5(√7 + 2) cm

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ∴ The correct answer is 6√5(√7 + 2) cm.
