                                                                                                                                                              Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Direct Common Tangent (DCT)

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              The common tangent that touches the two circles on the same side of the line joining their centers. Its length is always greater than the length of the Transverse Common Tangent.

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Transverse Common Tangent (TCT)

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              The common tangent that crosses the segment connecting the centers of the two circles. It exists only when the distance between centers is greater than the sum of their radii.

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Number of Tangents Based on Distance (d)

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              If d > r1 + r2, circles do not touch and have 4 common tangents (2 DCT, 2 TCT). If d = r1 + r2, circles touch externally and have exactly 3 common tangents.

                                                                                                                                                              दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              दो वृत्तों के केंद्रों के बीच की दूरी = 36 सेमी

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              पहले वृत्त की त्रिज्या (r1) = 15 सेमी

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              दूसरे वृत्त की त्रिज्या (r2) = 9 सेमी

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              उभयनिष्ठ स्पर्श रेखा की लंबाई (DCT) = \\(\\sqrt{d^2 - (r_1 - r_2)^2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              उभयनिष्ठ अनुप्रस्थ स्पर्श रेखा की लंबाई (TCT) = \\(\\sqrt{d^2 - (r_1 + r_2)^2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              गणना:

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              मान लीजिए कि वृत्तों के केंद्रों के बीच की दूरी d है।

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              यहाँ, d = 36 सेमी, r1 = 15 सेमी, और r2 = 9 सेमी।

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              उभयनिष्ठ स्पर्श रेखा की लंबाई (DCT) = \\(\\sqrt{36^2 - (15 - 9)^2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ DCT = \\(\\sqrt{1296 - 6^2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ DCT = \\(\\sqrt{1296 - 36}\\)

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ DCT = \\(\\sqrt{1260}\\)

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ DCT = 6√(35)

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              उभयनिष्ठ अनुप्रस्थ स्पर्श रेखा की लंबाई (TCT) = \\(\\sqrt{36^2 - (15 + 9)^2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ TCT = \\(\\sqrt{1296 - 24^2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ TCT = \\(\\sqrt{1296 - 576}\\)

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ TCT = \\(\\sqrt{720}\\)

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ TCT = 12√(5)

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              DCT और TCT की लंबाइयों का योग = 6√35 + 12√5

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ योग = √5(6√7 + 12)

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ योग = √5 ⋅ 6(√7 + 2)

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              इन दो वृत्तों की एक उभयनिष्ठ स्पर्श रेखा और एक उभयनिष्ठ अनुप्रस्थ स्पर्श रेखा की लंबाइयों का योग 6√5(√7 + 2) सेमी है।

                                                                                                                                                              Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                              Given: x2 + 7x + 8 = 0 ⇒ x2 + 8 = −7x

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Substitute x2 + 8 = −7x into the given expression:

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 4x / (x2 − 5x + 8) = 4x / (x2 + 8 − 5x)

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 4x / (−7x − 5x)

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 4x / (−12x) = −1/3

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ∴ The correct answer is −1/3.

                                                                                                                                                              Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                              Head start distance covered by P in 8 hours = 8 × 8 = 64 km.

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Relative speed of B (moving in the same direction) = 24 − 8 = 16 km/h.

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Time taken by B to catch P = 64 ÷ 16 = 4 hours.

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Distance from the starting point = B's speed × time = 24 × 4 = 96 km.

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ∴ The correct answer is 96 km.

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Given:

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Speed of P = 8 km/h

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Speed of B = 24 km/h

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Head start time for P = 8 hours

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n\n\n

                                                                                                                                                              Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Distance = Speed × Time

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Relative Speed (same direction) = Speed of B − Speed of P

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Catch-up Time = Initial Gap Distance ÷ Relative Speed

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              Calculations:

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ Distance covered by P before B starts = 8 × 8 = 64 km

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ This 64 km is the gap that B needs to cover to catch P.

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ Relative speed of B to P = 24 − 8 = 16 km/h

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ Time taken by B to close the gap = 64 ÷ 16 = 4 hours

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ Distance from the starting point = B's speed × Time taken

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ Distance = 24 × 4 = 96 km

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ∴ The correct answer is 96 km.

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Relative Speed (Same Direction)

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              When two objects travel in the same direction, their relative speed is the difference between their individual speeds: Relative Speed = S1 − S2.

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Catch-up Time Formula

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              The time required to overtake or catch a head-start object is given by: Time = Initial Gap Distance ÷ Relative Speed.

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Distance by Ratio Method

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              When the travel time is constant for two moving bodies, the ratio of the distances they cover is directly proportional to the ratio of their speeds: D1/D2 = S1/S2.

                                                                                                                                                              दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              P की गति = 8 किमी/घंटा

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              B की गति = 24 किमी/घंटा

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              P, B से 8 घंटे पहले चलना शुरू करता है।

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              दूरी = गति x समय

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              गणना:

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              8 घंटों में P द्वारा तय की गई दूरी = 8 किमी/घंटा x 8 घंटे

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 64 किमी

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              मान लीजिए कि B द्वारा P को पार करने में t घंटे लगते हैं।

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              t घंटों में, B, 24t किमी की दूरी तय करेगा।

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              t घंटों में, P, 8t किमी की दूरी तय करेगा।

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              P को पार करने के लिए, B को प्रारंभिक 64 किमी और t घंटों में P द्वारा तय की गई दूरी को तय करना होगा।

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              इसलिए, 24t = 64 + 8t

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 24t - 8t = 64

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 16t = 64

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ t = 64 / 16

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ t = 4 घंटे

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              4 घंटों में B द्वारा तय की गई दूरी = 24 किमी/घंटा x 4 घंटे

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 96 किमी

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              शुरुआती बिंदु से वह दूरी जहाँ B, P को पार सकता है, 96 किमी है।

                                                                                                                                                              ఇవ్వబడింది:

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              P వేగం = 8 కి.మీ/గం.

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              B వేగం = 24 కి.మీ/గం.

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              B కంటే 8 గంటల ముందు P నడవడం ప్రారంభిస్తాడు.

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ఉపయోగించిన సూత్రం:

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              దూరం = వేగం × సమయం

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              లెక్కింపు:

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              P 8 గంటల్లో ప్రయాణించిన దూరం = 8 కి.మీ/గం × 8 గం.

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 64 కి.మీ

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              P ని పట్టుకోవడానికి B పట్టే సమయం గంటలు అనుకుందాం.

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              t గంటల్లో, B 24t కి.మీ దూరం ప్రయాణిస్తాడు.

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              t గంటల్లో, P 8t కి.మీ దూరం ప్రయాణిస్తుంది.

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              P ని పట్టుకోవడానికి, B ప్రారంభ 64 కి.మీ.లను t గంటల్లో P ప్రయాణించే దూరాన్ని కలిపి ప్రయాణించాలి.

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              కాబట్టి, 24t = 64 + 8t

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 24t - 8t = 64

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 16t = 64

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ t = 64 / 16

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ t = 4 గంటలు

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              B 4 గంటల్లో ప్రయాణించిన దూరం = 24 కి.మీ/గం × 4 గం.

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 96 కి.మీ

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              B, P ని పట్టుకోగల ప్రారంభ స్థానం నుండి దూరం 96 కి.మీ.

                                                                                                                                                              दिलेले आहे:

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              P चा वेग = 8 किमी/तास

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              B चा वेग = 24 किमी/तास

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              P हा B च्या 8 तास आधी चालायला सुरुवात करतो

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              वापरलेले सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              अंतर = वेग × वेळ

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              गणना:

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              P ने 8 तासात पार केलेले अंतर = 8 किमी/तास × 8 तास 

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 64 किमी

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              समजा P ला पकडण्यासाठी B ला लागणारा वेळ t तास आहे.

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              B हा t तासात, 24t किमी अंतर पार करेल.

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              P हा t तासात, 8t किमी अंतर पार करेल.

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              P ला पकडण्यासाठी, B ला सुरुवातीचे 64 किमी तसेच P हे अंतर t तासात पार करावे लागेल.

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              म्हणून, 24t = 64 + 8t

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 24t - 8t = 64

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 16t = 64

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ t = 64 / 16

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ t = 4 तास

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              B द्वारे 4 तासात पार केलेले अंतर = 24 किमी/तास × 4 तास 

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 96 किमी

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              प्रारंभ स्थानापासूनचे अंतर जेथे B हा P ला पकडू शकतो ते अंतर 96 किमी आहे.​

                                                                                                                                                              প্রদত্ত:

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              P এর গতি = 8 কিমি/ঘন্টা

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              B এর গতি = 24 কিমি/ঘন্টা

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              P, B এর 8 ঘন্টা আগে হাঁটা শুরু করে।

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              সূত্র ব্যবহৃত:

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              দূরত্ব = গতি × সময়

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              গণনা:

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              P দ্বারা 8 ঘন্টায় ভ্রমণ করা দূরত্ব = 8 কিমি/ঘন্টা × 8 ঘন্টা

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 64 কিমি

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ধরি P B-কে ধরতে যে সময় লেগেছে তা t ঘন্টা 

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              t ঘন্টায়, B 24t কিমি দূরত্ব অতিক্রম করবে।

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              t ঘন্টায়, P 8t কিমি দূরত্ব অতিক্রম করবে।

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              P ধরতে, B কে প্রাথমিক 64 কিমি এবং P টি ঘন্টায় দূরত্ব অতিক্রম করতে হবে।

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              সুতরাং, 24t = 64 + 8t

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 24t - 8t = 64

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 16t = 64

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ t = 64 / 16

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ t = 4 ঘন্টা

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              4 ঘন্টায় B দ্বারা ভ্রমণ করা দূরত্ব = 24 কিমি/ঘন্টা × 4 ঘন্টা

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 96 কিমি

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              শুরু বিন্দু থেকে দূরত্ব যেখানে B P ধরতে পারে তা হল 96 কিমি।

                                                                                                                                                              P ની ઝડપ = 8 કિમી/ક

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              P, B કરતાં 8 કલાક પહેલા ચાલવાનું શરૂ કરે છે.

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 64 કિમી 

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ધારો કે B ને P ને પકડવામાં t કલાક લાગે છે.

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              P ને પકડવા માટે, B ને પ્રારંભિક 64 કિમી અને t કલાકમાં P દ્વારા કાપેલા અંતરને આવરી લેવાની જરૂર છે.

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              4 કલાકમાં B દ્વારા કાપેલું અંતર = 24કિમી/ક x 4 કલાક

                                                                                                                                                              கணக்கீடு:

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              8 மணிநேரத்தில் P பயணித்த தூரம் = 8 km/h × 8 h

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

Find his profit percentage.", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "35%"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "40%"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "38%"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "44%"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "रमेश ₹200 प्रति किताब की दर से 130 किताबें खरीदता है और उनमें से आधी किताबें ₹300 प्रति किताब की दर से, उसका पाँचवाँ भाग ₹350 प्रति किताब की दर से और बाकी किताबें क्रय मूल्य पर बेचता है। उसका लाभ प्रतिशत ज्ञात कीजिए।", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "35%"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "40%"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "38%"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "44%"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                              Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                              Let's find the average profit per book directly using fraction parts:

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Profit on 1/2 of books = ₹300 − ₹200 = ₹100

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Profit on 1/5 of books = ₹350 − ₹200 = ₹150

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Average profit = (1/2 × 100) + (1/5 × 150) + (3/10 × 0) = 50 + 30 = ₹80

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Profit % = (80 ÷ 200) × 100 = 40%

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ∴ The correct answer is 40%.

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Given:

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Total number of books = 130

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Cost price of each book = ₹200

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Profit = Total SP − Total CP

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Profit % = (Profit ÷ Total CP) × 100

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              Calculations:

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ Total CP of 130 books = 130 × 200 = ₹26,000

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ SP of half the books (130 ÷ 2 = 65) = 65 × 300 = ₹19,500

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ SP of one-fifth of the books (130 ÷ 5 = 26) = 26 × 350 = ₹9,100

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ Remaining books = 130 − (65 + 26) = 39

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ SP of remaining books at CP = 39 × 200 = ₹7,800

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ Total SP = 19,500 + 9,100 + 7,800 = ₹36,400

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ Profit = 36,400 − 26,000 = ₹10,400

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ Profit % = (10,400 ÷ 26,000) × 100 = 40%

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ∴ The correct answer is 40%.

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Weighted Average Profit/Loss

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              When different parts of a total quantity are sold at different profit or loss percentages, the net profit/loss % is the weighted sum of individual percentages.

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Profit and Loss Formulas

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Profit = Selling Price (SP) − Cost Price (CP). Profit percentage is always calculated on the base of Cost Price: Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100.

sin θ)(sec θ - cos θ)(tan θ + cot θ) ਦਾ ਮੁੱਲ ਲੱਭੋ।", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "0"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "1/2"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "1"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "-1"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                              Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                              Put θ = 45° in the given expression.

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Expression = (cosec 45° − sin 45°)(sec 45° − cos 45°)(tan 45° + cot 45°)

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ (√2 − 1/√2)(√2 − 1/√2)(1 + 1)

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ (1/√2) × (1/√2) × (2)

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ (1/2) × 2 = 1

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ∴ The correct answer is 1.

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Given:

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Expression: (cosec θ − sin θ)(sec θ − cos θ)(tan θ + cot θ)

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              cosec θ = 1/sin θ, sec θ = 1/cos θ

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              tan θ = sin θ/cos θ, cot θ = cos θ/sin θ

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              sin2 θ + cos2 θ = 1

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Calculations:

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ First term = (1/sin θ − sin θ) = (1 − sin2 θ)/sin θ = cos2 θ/sin θ

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ Second term = (1/cos θ − cos θ) = (1 − cos2 θ)/cos θ = sin2 θ/cos θ

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ Third term = (sin θ/cos θ + cos θ/sin θ) = (sin2 θ + cos2 θ)/(sin θ cos θ) = 1/(sin θ cos θ)

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ Product = (cos2 θ/sin θ) × (sin2 θ/cos θ) × 1/(sin θ cos θ)

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ Product = (cos2 θ × sin2 θ) ÷ (sin2 θ × cos2 θ)

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ Product = 1

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              ∴ The correct answer is 1.

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Value Substitution Trick

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              When simplifying trigonometric expressions without specified conditions, substituting an angle like θ = 45° gives a quick numerical result. Avoid values like 0° or 90° if they make any term undefined.

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Fundamental Trigonometric Identities

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              sin2 θ + cos2 θ = 1 | sec2 θ − tan2 θ = 1 | cosec2 θ − cot2 θ = 1

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              Reciprocal Ratios

                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                              sin θ × cosec θ = 1 | cos θ × sec θ = 1 | tan θ × cot θ = 1.
